about: Background music for Aurora's narrated videos (kno_story). Only recordings released free by their performers (CC0) or in the public domain by origin (Musopen, the US Air Force Band) — checked on Wikimedia Commons on 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-11 (25 more, owner's request); old transfers from records ("European Archive", 78 rpm) are left out: their freedom depends on the country. Downloaded once by script/story_music_fetch.py; the credit goes in each post.

moods.calm: reflective, philosophy, the mind, everyday wonders told gently
moods.wonder: the cosmos, nature at large, discoveries, light and space
moods.melancholy: history, loss, limits, ethics, the human condition
moods.lively: experiments, technology, how machines work, energy, motion
moods.mystery: the unknown, paradoxes, quantum physics, open questions
